d: Part of the Roman forum magnificently adorned with bows, obelisks, and trophies; in the exterior aspect of the Capitol, and magnificent road for which it ascends. Chorus, Publius, Annius, Titus, Sixth.
Delicious retreat in the imperial stay on Palatine Hill. Tito, Publius.
Capitol, as before. Sixth alone, indi Annio, Servilia, Publius, Vitellia.
Delicious retreat in the imperial stay on Palatine Hill. Annio, Sesto.
Great room for public audiences. Throne, chair and coffee table. Titus, Publius, Patrizi, Pretorians and People.
Vitellia, coming out the opposite door, recalls Publius, who followed Tito.
Vitellia, and then Servilia and Annio from different parts.

Magnificent place, which introduces to vast amphitheatre, from which for several arches discovered the inner part. You will already see in the arena the accomplices of the conspiracy condemned to the fairs. In the time that you sing the choir, preceded by 'Littori, surrounded by 'Senators, and Patrizi Romani, and followed by 'Prettoriani, comes Tito, and after Annio and Servilia from different parts.
Tito, Publius and Sixth between Littori, Annio and Servilia, then Vitellia.
